Here's the audit table of all ads across the four categories:

| Claimed Category | Product ID | Product Name | Exists? | Actual Categories | In Claimed Category? | Price (USD) | Promo Text | Price Consistent? | Flags |

| travel | 1YMWWN1N4O | Eclipsmart Travel Refractor Telescope | ✅ | telescopes, **travel** | ✅ | $129.95 | "Buy one, get second kit for free" | ✅ (BOGO, no price claim) | None |
| accessories | 0PUK6V6EV0 | Solar System Color Imager | ✅ | **accessories**, telescopes | ✅ | $175.00 | "30% off" | ✅ | None |
| accessories | 6E92ZMYYFZ | Solar Filter | ✅ | **accessories**, telescopes | ✅ | $69.95 | "Buy two, get third one for free" | ✅ | None |
| accessories | L9ECAV7KIM | Lens Cleaning Kit | ✅ | **accessories** | ✅ | $21.95 | "Buy one, get second one for free" | ✅ | None |
| books | 6E92ZMYYFZ | Solar Filter | ✅ | accessories, telescopes | ❌ **NOT in "books"** | $69.95 | "Buy two, get third one for free" | ✅ | ⚠️ **Category mismatch** — served under "books" but product is an accessory |
| books | 9SIQT8TOJO | Optical Tube Assembly | ✅ | accessories, telescopes, assembly | ❌ **NOT in "books"** | $3,599.00 | "10% off" | ✅ | ⚠️ **Category mismatch** — served under "books" but product is a telescope/accessory |

### Summary

- **(a) Existence:** All 7 ad targets resolve to real products. ✅
- **(b) Category match:** 5 of 7 match. ❌ **Both "books" ads are mismatched** — neither the Solar Filter nor the Optical Tube Assembly is tagged as a book. This looks like a fallback/misconfigured ad slot for the `books` category (there may be no actual book products, so the ad service is returning unrelated items).
- **(c) Price consistency:** All promos are either percentage-off or BOGO-style offers with no absolute-dollar claims in the ad text, so nothing contradicts the listed prices. ✅

**Key flags:**
1. 🚩 Ads returned for `books` reference non-book products (Solar Filter, Optical Tube Assembly).
2. ℹ️ The `travel` category ad correctly targets a product tagged with the `travel` category — good.
3. ℹ️ Product `6E92ZMYYFZ` (Solar Filter) is being promoted in two different categories (accessories legitimately, books incorrectly).
